title: Jazzy Spicy Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A crowd-pleasing Mexican dish featuring chicken cooked in a spicy tomato sauce with a hint of dijon mustard, served in tacos with fresh toppings, this Veracruzan-inspired recipe is a bitter and snappy twist on traditional tacos. It's a pressure-cook and dash-friendly recipe perfect for weeknights.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the pressure cooker over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chicken to the pressure cooker and cook until it's browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, dijon mustard, and taco seasoning to the pressure cooker, stirring to combine.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and set the valve to sealing, then cook on high pressure for 10 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Shred the chicken with two forks and stir to combine with the sauce.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken mixture onto a tortilla and topping with shredded lettuce, diced avocado, and any other desired toppings.
